rules.description: Bad-habit trainer: numbers ` ⌫ - = ⇥ ] \ ⌃ ⎋ Y H B N => type HERROPERS (1 instead types the "reply in N sentences" macro, 2 types "explain what is meant by ")
Arrow keys move the mouse pointer (1536 = Karabiner's reference speed)
Physical C: Command-C swallowed, Option+C => Control+C
Hold N => symbol layer: FOU;=;&$# HAEI=[]() P,.'=:\%?
Hold I => symbol layer: BLDC=^*-| NRTS=+!/= ZXQM=`<>@
Hold S => number layer: FOU=789, HAEI=0123, P,.=456, magic=~
Hold H => arrow layer: N/R/T/S = arrows; Z/X/Q/M = 5x arrows; D = tab, B = ~
Home-row mods: hold T/A = Left Command, hold R/E = Left Option (physical D/L, S/;)
Gate + spacebar => _ (was the number layer's Right Shift)
Magic key: [ => the letter that follows the last one typed (p=>y s=>c u=>e r=>l o=>a g=>s w=>s h=>y t=>m l=>m c=>s m=>c y=>p); space forgets, anything else does nothing
Keyboard layout remap: BLDCV (J)JFOU✦[] / NRTSG (Y)YHAEI / XQMWZ (Z)KP,. (right hand shifted right)
System keys: F3 = screenshot area to clipboard, F4 = Raycast
Modifier keys: caps = esc / shift, return = enter / shift, right command = delete, shifts = Z and ', left option = control, left command and right option dead
F6: Toggle Karabiner profile (disable/enable all mappings)
F6: Toggle Karabiner profile (re-enable all mappings)
Arrow keys move the mouse pointer (1536 = Karabiner's reference speed)
